title: Grandma June's All-Day Stew
subtitle: Thanksgiving in a closet-sized kitchen. Grandma's bean stew takes all day. Jo has until five.
end: Is the Instant Pot Duo worth it this Black Friday? Our full review and the price to wait for are below.
style: Autumn holiday palette: warm amber and cranberry kitchen light, brushed-steel highlights, cozy golden evening.

art.prompt: Thanksgiving morning in a tiny city apartment kitchen barely wider than a closet: Jo, flour on her glasses and apron, stirs one pot while all four stove burners are crammed with bubbling pots, a roasting turkey fills the small oven behind its glowing window, cutting boards balance across the sink and blank sticky notes cover the cabinets. Comic chaos, warm amber morning light. Full-bleed single image, edge to edge, no split frames.

items.text: Thanksgiving. Jo's first time hosting. Her kitchen is closet-sized.

art.prompt: June in her own cozy kitchen on a video call, proudly holding up a worn handwritten recipe card (the writing abstract and unreadable) and a big wooden spoon, beaming; an old enamel stew pot simmers on the stove behind her. Warm autumn light through a lace curtain. The phone is out of frame. Full-bleed single image, edge to edge, no split frames.

items.text: Don't forget my bean stew, dear. It simmers all day!

art.prompt: Comedic shock close-up of Jo in her tiny kitchen, glasses askew, eyes huge, jaw dropped, manga shock lines radiating behind her; a pot lid flies off the crowded stove and a small saucepan is balanced precariously on top of a toaster; steam everywhere. Full-bleed single image, edge to edge, no split frames.

items.text: All day?! You're coming at five!

art.prompt: Jo on tiptoe on a small step stool, reaching into a high kitchen cupboard and pulling down a dusty, unopened plain cardboard box tied with a faded red gift ribbon; a beam of light catches the floating dust; her face lights up in a hopeful, comic eureka moment. Full-bleed single image, edge to edge, no split frames.

items.text: Grandma's gift from last Christmas. Still in the box.

art.prompt: In the tiny kitchen, a gleaming stainless electric pressure cooker with a black lid and a small blank front control panel sits on the one clear corner of the counter, lid locked, a calm glow around it, while the crowded stove still bubbles behind; in the foreground Jo has finally sat down on a kitchen stool, eyes closed, holding a mug of tea with both hands, blissfully relieved. Warm golden light. Full-bleed single image, edge to edge, no split frames.

items.text: Owners praise its speed: one pot for rice, beans, stews, soup, yogurt.

art.prompt: Vera leans into the scene beside a gleaming stainless electric pressure cooker with a black lid, one hand raised like a friendly teacher sharing a secret with the viewer, a soft autumn-gold glow and a few drifting maple leaves around her; calm, confident, warm. Full-bleed single image, edge to edge, no split frames.

items.text: Want one? List is $109.99. Last Black Friday: about 36% off.
Instant Pot's store, Nov 17, 2026; Bob Vila, Nov 28, 2025.

art.prompt: Evening at the apartment door: Jo, apron on and a little flushed but smiling, opens the door; June stands in the hallway in a lavender coat holding a pie, sniffing the air with delighted surprise; behind Jo in the tiny kitchen the stainless electric pressure cooker sits on the counter with its lid on and a gentle wisp of steam. Warm golden light spilling into the hall. Full-bleed single image, edge to edge, no split frames.

Heartwarming Thanksgiving night: Jo and June sit side by side at a small candlelit table in the tiny apartment, crowded with a roast turkey, a pie and bowls of steaming bean stew; June rests her hand over Jo's and both laugh warmly; city lights twinkle at dusk through the window. Cozy amber and cranberry glow. Full-bleed single image, edge to edge, no split frames.

items.text: I always spent Thanksgiving stirring that pot.
This year, you just sit with me.
